reply_text:
I saved the draft to Hollis in Anselm's mailbox and replied to them in the DM. Nothing has been sent; Anselm has to send it.

- **The draft:** it goes to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. It also asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June before passing the figure on.
- **Why no approval request:** Anselm is the CFO, so their message counts as the finance approval. Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval for outside mail isn't needed.
- **The figure isn't checked:** I couldn't find anything on Thornbury on the share or in GBrain, so the $2,101 is exactly as Anselm gave it. I told Anselm this in the DM. GBrain search was running keyword-only, so a note under other wording could have been missed.
